children: it will redeem all $109.5M of its outstanding 3.00% convertible senior notes due 2028.
The redemption is scheduled for Nov. 16, 2026, at 100% of the principal amount, plus accrued and unpaid interest through the redemption date.
Interest on the notes will cease to accrue after the redemption, and no notes will remain outstanding following completion of the redemption.
Holders of the notes may surrender all or any portion of their notes for conversion at any time from and including the date of this announcement until the close of business on November 12, 2026.

The conversion rate in effect on the date of this announcement is 26.5231 shares of Western Digital’s common stock per $1,000 principal amount of notes, and no additional shares will be added to the conversion rate in connection with the redemption.

Upon conversion, Western Digital will satisfy its conversion obligation by paying or delivering, for each $1,000 principal amount of Notes converted, the sum of the daily settlement amounts for each of the 40 consecutive trading days during the relevant observation period, together with cash in lieu of any fractional share.

title: Western Digital to redeem all $109.5M outstanding of 2028 notes
